title: Online Versatile Incremental Learning: Towards Class and Domain-Agnostic Adaptation at Any Time
abstract: arXiv:2609.36442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning enables vision systems to adapt to ever-changing data distributions. Despite significant advances, existing approaches fail to capture continuous and concurrent shifts in classes and domains, a critical capability for real-world deployment. This work introduces Online VIL (Online Versatile Incremental Learning), a novel scenario where class concepts and visual domains evolve simultaneously online without explicit boundaries. To better adapt to the challenges of such dynamic environments that more closely resemble real-world conditions, we propose a novel framework TopFlow, Topology preservation with Flow matching representation that contains two complementary mechanisms: Domain-agnostic Flow Matching (DFM) and Global Topology Preservation (GTP). translated_title: 在线多功能增量学习：迈向随时随地的类别与域无关自适应
translated_abstract: 持续学习使视觉系统能够适应不断变化的数据分布。尽管已取得重大进展，现有方法仍无法捕捉类别与域同时发生的连续性变化，而这正是现实世界部署中的一项关键能力。本工作提出了在线VIL（在线多功能增量学习）这一新场景，其中类别概念与视觉域在没有明确边界的情况下同时在线演化。为了更好地应对这种更贴近现实条件的动态环境带来的挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的框架TopFlow（结合流匹配表示的拓扑保持），它包含两个互补机制：域无关流匹配（DFM）和全局拓扑保持（GTP）。DFM通过将测地流核融入对比学习，引导模型获得域无关的表示；与之相对，GTP则维护全局结构（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出在线多功能增量学习新场景以及TopFlow框架，通过域无关流匹配与全局拓扑保持两种互补机制，实现类别与视觉域在线同时无边界演化时的自适应学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Online VIL, a new continual learning scenario where class concepts and visual domains evolve simultaneously online without explicit boundaries, and proposes the TopFlow framework with Domain-agnostic Flow Matching and Global Topology Preservation to enable robust adaptation in such dynamic environments.
